## Photronics to Participate in Upcoming Investor Events


February 4, 2026 at 8:02 AM EST


[PDF Version](https://photronicsinc.gcs-web.com/node/19221/pdf)


BROOKFIELD, Conn., Feb. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Photronics, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=4fJKxktowPrHQdys_bjnjf5WFYlKB8W_pWnb__w5hUbuIcjXZK2BVIXOYsIh0DYNgIgnwhv6dy83N8TrgBKCyqc80v0vmXpIsX-VHOkvzbx3FMWKA7jFZkSgoqcczlBi) (Nasdaq:PLAB), a worldwide leader in photomask technologies and solutions, today announced the following upcoming investor events:


**FQ1 2026 Financial Results**
Date: February 25, 2026
Webcast:[Photronics, Inc. - Events and Presentations](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=4fJKxktowPrHQdys_bjnjc_hXbb4rnCt5q8__8447kTZLSBZd_nzgUhWdj8a3WH1TJEuehd0oKkiaSZK2-tFFsA6a-24FTv2MxueL1vINu0MtPzhuCT1LIkk3S6m_PI94Hc-vW0-o6flYepsY-xk8w6J1LY4YmPYzH20V93b5pI=)


**Susquehanna 15** **th** **Annual Technology Conference**
Date: February 26, 2026
Location: NYC


**OFC Trade Show**
Date: March 17-18, 2026
Location: Los Angeles
Institutional investors should reach out to Photronics investor relations to schedule a meeting.


**About Photronics**


[Photronics](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=4fJKxktowPrHQdys_bjnjU-99BfUAwEErvtkXvFuEdisvPFFOpGbYmg391cMmcmJXPONKMnALrFqicVujAZLyvqaQ5gqJV0UxwzpU3-f2Dc=) is a leading worldwide manufacturer of integrated circuit (IC) and flat panel display (FPD)[photomasks](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=qt2qVnX79XMF-oEt5fH9ISdPek1d6bt_O2v5YZ47roxxGnfAvnqId2xwRdyk2feNQgXxi_9jL72THZi0QMmVUOOZ6Toz0kV1dLtBf1I6mVzzQASxlajQQXznWMvjiQdZ7cYXPFRE2To3FQRa3-wdgM30zXSnT94HUJanstQrwQo=) . High precision quartz plates that contain microscopic images of electronic circuits, photomasks are a key element in the IC and FPD manufacturing process. Founded in 1969, Photronics has been a trusted photomask supplier for over 56 years. The company operates 11 strategically located[manufacturing facilities](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=PMjk04U5yZSnmHbGfAgBQWLPEAkSo8KNNlQDmGl6pdaSo9DdrGOCn6XklEjgdpH00uL9qufWXAhpVWMIYWqnoQx7hWCWId2NzeStC9xnuAQ2eRbODpNZiAAyLxn_yE7vVcvqGiTpLwxAt7MhNYq_9g==) in Asia, Europe, and North America. Additional information on the company can be accessed at[www.photronics.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=zH6_a6h4q4iX6z8qHJODE9i8_aFzrJdSLuEpgOUIy9evJQd5SiEK0KeNWsxEWTfO-ZAUW1D2qGjyO2Gry5h1UT8r5H4xzhrI8_4SCRroZDg=) .
